'''Robert Seville''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2001 Anderson tournament]] on 21 July 2001 with Tatooine podracing, according to Brad Reinhold's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2745">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-30-anderson-1-week-before-dpc-atlantad2745/ anderson-1-week-before-dpc-atlanta], DeckTech (Brad "Admiral Twk" Reinhold, 30 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-30-anderson-1-week-before-dpc-atlantad2745/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
